stories.title: B.C. NDP interim leader talks about strength in Opposition as 26 MLAs are sworn in
stories.summary: Jennifer Whiteside addressed the house to talk about the privilege of serving as an MLA and pledged the NDP would be a strong Opposition.

stories.title: One arrested after break-and-enter, assault in Victoria home
stories.summary: The victim and the suspect are known to each other, say VicPD.

stories.title: Saanich gives developer two weeks to adjust 18-storey project proposal
stories.summary: The project proposed for 3468 Tillicum Rd. combines rental residential living, a hotel and commercial space.

stories.title: B.C. Lions owner says team wants to own or operate provincially controlled BC Place
stories.summary: VANCOUVER — B.C. Lions owner Amar Doman says the CFL team is interested in owning or operating BC Place, its home stadium in Vancouver.

stories.title: Carney in Saskatchewan to campaign for long-shot byelection win
stories.summary: YORKTON — Prime Minister Mark Carney campaigned Thursday in Yorkton, Sask., for a byelection in a riding his party has never won in its nearly 60 years of existence. The byelection in Yorkton—Melville is one of six which will be decided on Dec. 7.

stories.title: Moe and Carney talk economy, electricity and trade during Regina visit
stories.summary: REGINA — Prime Minister Mark Carney and Saskatchewan Premier Scott Moe shook hands and smiled Thursday before meeting behind closed doors in Regina. It's believed to be the first time Carney has visited Saskatchewan's capital as prime minister.

stories.title: B.C. New Democrats are sworn in as Official Opposition, with vow to win next election
stories.summary: VICTORIA — British Columbia New Democrats assumed their role as the Official Opposition on Thursday a month after an election drubbing, but the party is planning for victory in the next election, former cabinet minister Adrian Dix said.

stories.title: Tories want PM's wife Diana Fox Carney to testify to Parliament on oceans role
stories.summary: OTTAWA — The Conservatives are calling on Prime Minister Mark Carney's wife to testify to Parliament on her role as ocean envoy, arguing the government is not being transparent about her responsibilities and possible lobbying concerns.

stories.title: Tankard rides the rails again as Brier marks 100th anniversary in 2027
stories.summary: The Tankard is going on a long train ride. The Canadian men’s curling championship trophy will travel 2,655 kilometres by rail from Toronto to Saskatoon to mark the 100th anniversary of the Brier.
